title: ねこ撮影
style_en: Clean black ink line art with light gray screentone shading, simple expressive faces

characters.name: ミナ
characters.look_ja: 黒髪ショートボブ、白いパーカー、スマホを持つ
characters.look_en: a young woman with a short dark bob haircut, a white hoodie and a smartphone

characters.name: ねこ
characters.look_en: a small fluffy orange tabby cat

panels.beat_ja: 塀の上の猫を見つけてスマホを構える
panels.background_en: A quiet residential street with a low concrete wall in soft afternoon light

cast.acting_en: spotting the cat with wide sparkling eyes, holding her smartphone up excitedly
cast.acting_ja: 目を輝かせてスマホを構える

cast.acting_en: sitting calmly on top of the wall

panels.background_en: Closer view of the same concrete wall

cast.acting_en: tiptoeing toward the cat in an exaggerated sneaking pose, crouched low, phone held out with both hands, a small sweat drop near her head
curled up with eyes half closed

panels.beat_ja: 猫が飛びかかってくる

cast.acting_en: recoiling in shock with a startled face, phone nearly slipping from her hand
leaping through the air toward her with legs spread

panels.beat_ja: 頭に猫を乗せたまま自撮り
panels.background_en: Plain light background with a few sparkle accents

cast.acting_en: front-facing selfie pose with a deadpan, slightly defeated expression, while the orange tabby cat sits contentedly on top of her head looking at the camera
